name: Edge of Divinity
description:
About This Game

Edge of Divinity is an action, anime-inspired roguelite featuring our protagonists Effy and Kira as they make the Ascent through the Tower to reach the Celestial Realm that awaits them at the top.

  • Magical girls in a divine world: Help Effy find her place in the Celestial Realm and Kira in finding clues on the whereabouts of her sister through this action adventure.

  • Singleplayer plus online co-op action roguelite: Team up with other players to ascend the Tower, get kicked back down to basecamp, get upgrades, and try again!

  • Unique fantasy biomes: Explore magical biomes with different creatures as you make the Ascent.
short_desc: Ascend the Tower as Effy and Kira in this fantasy, anime-inspired action roguelite. Explore magical biomes, gain power ups, and fight enemies to reach the Celestial Realm (or get kicked back down to basecamp!)
